mapper.sql: SELECT s.*, u.username, u.nickname, a.title AS activity_title FROM volunteer_sign s LEFT JOIN user u ON s.user_id = u.user_id LEFT JOIN activity a ON s.activity_id = a.activity_id
mapper.select: WHERE s.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY s.sign_in_time DESC, s.sign_id DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO volunteer_sign (user_id, activity_id, sign_date, sign_in_time, work_hours, service_type, content, status, audit_status, create_time) VALUES (#{userId}, #{activityId}, CURDATE(), NOW(), 0, #{serviceType}, #{content}, 1, 1, NOW())
mapper.update: UPDATE volunteer_sign SET sign_out_time = NOW(), work_hours = #{workHours}, status = 2 WHERE sign_id = #{signId} AND status = 1
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM volunteer_sign WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND status = 1

SELECT u.user_id AS user_id, u.username AS username, u.nickname AS nickname, COUNT(*) AS sign_count, SUM(CASE WHEN s.status = 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS finish_count, SUM(CASE WHEN s.audit_status = 2 THEN s.work_hours ELSE 0 END) AS total_hours FROM volunteer_sign s LEFT JOIN user u ON s.user_id = u.user_id WHERE s.status != 3 GROUP BY u.user_id, u.username, u.nickname ORDER BY total_hours DESC, sign_count DESC

SELECT COUNT(*) AS sign_total, COUNT(DISTINCT user_id) AS volunteer_total, SUM(CASE WHEN status = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS signing_now, SUM(CASE WHEN sign_date = CURDATE() THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS sign_today, SUM(CASE WHEN audit_status = 1 AND status = 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS audit_pending, SUM(CASE WHEN audit_status = 2 THEN work_hours ELSE 0 END) AS hours_total FROM volunteer_sign WHERE status != 3

SELECT COUNT(*) AS sign_count, SUM(CASE WHEN audit_status = 2 THEN work_hours ELSE 0 END) AS total_hours, SUM(CASE WHEN status = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS signing_now FROM volunteer_sign WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND status != 3
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM volunteer_sign WHERE sign_date = CURDATE() AND status != 3
SELECT user_id FROM volunteer_sign WHERE sign_id = #{signId}
mapper.update: UPDATE volunteer SET work_hours = ( SELECT IFNULL(SUM(work_hours), 0) FROM volunteer_sign WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND audit_status = 2 AND status = 2 ) WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND audit_status = 2
